Ys 1 - Devil_s Step - Arranged by Atsushi Watanabe (Japan)
Ys 1 - First Step Towards Wars - Arranged by Atsushi Watanabe (Japan)
Ys 1 - In the Memory - Arranged by Atsushi Watanabe (Japan)
Ys 1 - Palace of Destruction - Arranged by Atsushi Watanabe (Japan)
Ys 1 - The Last Moment of the Dark - Arranged by Atsushi Watanabe (Japan)
Ys 1 - The Syonin - Arranged by Atsushi Watanabe (Japan)
Mikeneko Holmes - Ghost Panic
game.desc: Mikeneko Holmes: Ghost Panic is a mystery game based on popular Mikeneko Holmes novels by Akagawa Jir?, a Japanese mystery novel writer. The protagonist in this mystery story is none other than Holmes, the cat, not Sherlock, who got involved in a murder incident in an old castle somewhere in southern part of Germany, which is nowadays used as a sightseeing hotel. Ancient legends about witches, demons and strange phenomena are well known in the area, which adds a touch of supernatural to be feared of, if any of it true. This game is made to play as a sound comic, meaning the artwork is made as an interactive comic book which progresses the story, yet allowing the player to enter choices which will take the story in a different direction and lead to one of several different endings.

game.name: Raku Jongg
game.desc: Imagina Puyo Puyo o Panic Bomber, pero con fichas de Mahjong en su lugar.

game.name: Tonpusou
game.desc: Standard play mechanics, though an understanding of Japanese is an advantage.

game.name: XI -sai- Little
game.desc: "Roll the dice game will be off the edge. I know that someone you know is a famous game. Chain can not be perplexed in the beginning, when man used to enjoy! Highly addictive puzzle. I

game.name: Battle Spirit : Digimon Frontier
game.desc: The plot of Digimon Battle Spirit 2 echoes that of its source series, Digimon Frontier; several children receive messages on their cell phones asking them if they want their lives to change. Some answer yes, some answer no, and five who answer yes are summoned to the Digital World where they receive the ability to become Digimon and fight to end Kerpymon's reign of terror.

game.name: Digimon Digital Monsters - Anode And Cathode Tamer - Veedramon Version
game.desc: Este cartucho contiene la primera Digimon Adventure, tanto en la versión Anode Tamer como en la Cathode Tamer. El juego está basado en la serie de manga y anime Digimon. Juegas como un chico japonés común y corriente llamado Ryou que es absorbido por el misterioso mundo digital y tiene que ayudar al monstruo digital Agumon y sus amigos a reclutar monstruos digitales y enviarlos a batallas contra otros monstruos enemigos.

game.name: Digimon Tamers - Battle Spirit
game.desc: Digimon Battle Spirit es un juego de lucha publicado originalmente por Bandai y desarrollado por Dimps para el sistema portátil WonderSwan Color, disponible solo en Japón, bajo el nombre de Digimon Tamers: Battle Spirit. Fue posteriormente portado a la consola Game Boy Advance de Nintendo para su lanzamiento internacional en América del Norte y Europa dos años después. El juego presenta personajes y Digimon incluidos en las primeras tres temporadas de la serie de animación del mismo nombre en un escenario de lucha algo simplista, y también cuenta con muestras ligeramente arregladas de la banda sonora del programa.

game.name: Digimon Tamers - Battle Spirit Ver.1.5
game.desc: Digimon Tamers: Battle Spirit Ver. 1.5 is a fighting game developed and published by Bandai and released exclusively in Japan for the WonderSwan Color handheld console. It is an expansion to Digimon Tamers: Battle Spirit (released in the United States and Europe as Digimon Battle Spirit) and contains many new features and characters. Unlike its predecessor or sequel, Digimon Battle Spirit 2, this game did not receive a Game Boy Advance port.

game.name: Final Fantasy
game.desc: Final Fantasy de Hironobu Sakaguchi ... la primera de una de las series de juegos de rol más largas conocidas por la humanidad. Final Fantasy es el juego para la consola NES que lo comenzó todo. El mundo está velado en la oscuridad. Los vientos no soplan, los mares son tormentosos y la tierra se pudre. Todo lo que la gente puede esperar es que la antigua profecía se cumpla finalmente. "Cuando el mundo esté velado en la oscuridad, vendrán cuatro guerreros ..." Y, de hecho, vienen: los cuatro personajes que elegiste previamente. Su primera búsqueda es liberar a una princesa de la malvada Garland, y luego comienza el verdadero viaje ... Final Fantasy se juega con una fiesta de aventuras en lugar de con un solo personaje. Antes de que comience el juego, el jugador elige cuatro personajes de seis clases diferentes: luchador, ladrón, cinturón negro, mago blanco, mago rojo y mago negro. Las cuatro clases que el jugador elige para sus personajes depende totalmente de él. También le da nombres a los personajes.

game.name: Final Fantasy II
game.desc: FINAL FANTASY II es la esperada continuación del FINAL FANTASY original. El juego presenta la amarga y hermosa historia de cuatro héroes huérfanos de guerra que se ven envueltos en un conflicto entre el hostil Imperio de Palamecia y los rebeldes. Al abandonar los niveles convencionales en favor de un sistema de habilidades que permite a los jugadores personalizar el crecimiento de sus personajes e incorporar un sistema de memoria de términos clave que hace que el diálogo sea una parte integral del juego, este juego ha despertado el espíritu de innovación que ha hecho a la serie famosa. Esta versión también contiene las mazmorras adicionales agregadas en ediciones posteriores del juego: Soul of Rebirth y Arcane Labyrinth.

game.name: Final Fantasy IV
game.desc: Esta es la cuarta entrega de la serie Final Fantasy. Internacionalmente se la conoce como Final Fantasy II, ya que los juegos segundo y tercero nunca se lanzaron fuera de Japón. El país militar de Baron es uno de los más fuertes de la región, con un ejército orgulloso y una majestuosa fuerza aérea conocida como las Alas Rojas. Pero, aunque sus ejércitos son amables y leales, las acciones recientes del Rey son todo menos eso. Se le ordena al joven Capitán de las Alas Rojas, Cecil, que robe un cristal de un pueblo de magos inocentes, y cuando cuestiona las acciones de su Rey, Cecil es inmediatamente expulsado del país y enviado a matar a extraños monstruos. Poco se da cuenta del precio que pagarán las acciones del Rey y de cuál es el verdadero secreto de los cristales y sus poderes.

game.name: Final Lap Special - GT & Formula Machine
game.desc: Final Lap Special ofrece dos modos de juego: GT Machine y Formula Machine. El modo GT Machine es un modo potente y dinámico que conduce en una pista especial en modo GT que también incluye caminos sin pavimentar. El modo Formula Machine es un modo que captura curvas rápidas y curvas cerradas con un manejo rápido y duro. Hay más de 30 pistas diferentes en el juego y los rivales (manejados por la CPU) que aparecen en el campeonato son tienen diferentes técnicas de conducción. El juego también admite competición de 2 jugadores a través de un cable de comunicación. Además, existen diferentes tipos de minijuegos, incluidos minijuegos en los que conduces por carreteras estrechas sin desviarte del camino.

game.name: One Piece Grand Battle : Swan Colosseum
game.desc: One Piece: Grand Battle Swan Colosseum funciona de forma muy parecida a Super Smash Bros. El juego se desarrolla en un plano 2D y los niveles son grandes y libremente navegables. Hay dos tipos básicos de ataques, ataques ligeros y fuertes. Además, también hay ataques especiales haciendo ciertas combinaciones de botones y súper ataques que se pueden hacer cuando los jugadores llenan un súper medidor. El juego solo tiene dos luchadores en la pantalla a la vez, pero es muy rápido y fluido. El modo multijugador está disponible cuando usas el cable de conexión Wonderswan para conectar dos sistemas Wonderswan Color.

game.name: Golden Axe
game.desc: Versión para WonderSwan Color del clásico de Sega, Golden Axe. Como en las ediciones anteriores (excepto la versión de Master System), podemos elegir entre tres héroes, cada uno con sus características y magias propias. Lucha por derrotar al malvado Death-Adder, acabar con su tiranía y poder recuperar el hacha dorada. Cabe decir que Golden Axe es uno de los mejores videojuegos de la historia de Sega.

game.name: Guilty Gear Petit
game.desc: Este juego tiene lugar en el siglo XXII. Los científicos desarrollaron una nueva técnica que les permitió fusionar el ADN de humanos y animales, produciendo poderosas criaturas conocidas como "gears". Los personajes del juego participan en un torneo, cuyo ganador se enfrentaría a un gear que se salió de control y amenaza con liderar una rebelión contra los humanos. El juego te permite jugar como personajes familiares de la serie Guilty Gear, como el héroe principal Sol Badguy, que tiene una cierta conexión con los gears, y su rival, el líder de los Caballeros Sagrados llamado Ky Kiske. También presenta un nuevo personaje, la enfermera Fanny, que lucha con una jeringa y tiene una conexión misteriosa con el genio cirujano y más tarde asesino en serie, el Dr. Baldhead.

game.name: Guilty Gear Petit 2
game.desc: En el siglo XXII, los científicos encontraron una manera de crear seres hibridos artificiales a los que llamaron "gears". Estos gears eran muy poderosos, pero no tenían voluntad propia y eran completamente obedientes a los humanos. Sin embargo, un gear llamado Justice pudo liberarse del control y lideró una rebelión contra los humanos. Desde entonces, la humanidad vivió con el temor de que algún día los gears obtuvieran el poder en la Tierra. Para ello, la Orden de los Caballeros Sagrados organizó torneos de lucha para descubrir quién es lo suficientemente fuerte para enfrentarse a los gears renegados.

game.name: Hataraku Chocobo
game.desc: Hataraku Chocobo is a farm simulation game where you take on the role of a chocobo breeder who has his work cut out for him!

game.name: Makai Toushi Sa-Ga
game.desc: El juego cuenta la historia de cuatro héroes que intentan escalar una torre ubicada en el centro del mundo, la cual, supuestamente conduce al paraíso. Estos pueden pertenecer a una de las tres clases de personaje, llevando así a una personalización única del juego.

game.name: Mr. Driller
game.desc: El mundo de Mr Driller se ha cubierto de bloques misteriosos. Armado únicamente con un potente taladro, deberás cavar hasta ponerte a salvo antes de que se agote su suministro de aire. Mr. Driller es un juego de puzzle en tiempo real que se basa únicamente en la rapidez mental y un poco de planificación. El modo de juego es una combinación de Tetris y Boulder Dash: tienes que taladrar a través de bloques multicolores para llegar al fondo mientras evitas que los bloques de la parte superior se caigan y te aplasten por taladrar demasiado.

game.name: Rhyme Rider Kerorican
game.desc: You play as the rhyme rider Kerorcian, a vivacious space girl with a large frog helmet, as she skips to the music through the games four stages. The games music is largely comprised of jazzy techno pieces. Kerorcian skips down a set line while randomly placed enemies and obstacles appear before her. Various button combos will avoid certain obstacles, although a "one-button" easy mode is available. When you avoid an obstacle a note will sound, clearing long chains of obstacles will result in funky melodies popping up inside the song that is playing. This gameplay is reminiscent of the studios earlier game Vib Ribbon. Some of the obstacles are interactive, such as a rocket one can jump on and ride a short distance, others can merely be kicked out of the way or jumped over. Occasionally a crown will appear over an obstacle, if you successfully clear it you will briefly soar over the stage avoiding anything that might have been in your path. This is especially common before obstacles that might require outlandish button combos.

game.name: Riviera - Yakusoku no Chi Riviera
game.desc: Riviera: The Promised Land is a turn based role playing game. It follows a traditional RPG formula - once peaceful land now ravaged by demons and their wars with angels. However, it also incorporates a "dating sim" as a subplot where your character must win affection of another character. It has similarities to Fire Emblem, Final Fantasy Tactics, Golden Sun and a number of others. Reaching high levels is important to make the game not too difficult at the end. The levelling up is similar to Secret of Mana, where the weapon skill for a character increases at a different rate to the character levels.

game.name: Rockman EXE - N1 Battle
game.desc: Taking place within the timeline of the Battle Network series, Rockman EXE N1 Battle involves a battling tournament called the "Battle Chip GP" among various pairs of online avatars called "NetNavis" and their human operators. Rather than directly control the player character through the traditional real-time tactical role-playing battles of the other Battle Network games, Rockman EXE N1 Battle tasks the player with creating a "Program Deck" made up of abilities called "Battle Chips". The game randomly selects chips for the player and executes them in a duel with a computer-controlled opponent.

game.name: Rockman EXE WS
game.desc: Rockman EXE WS es un spin-off vagamente basado en la adaptación animada de Mega Man Battle Network. El juego intenta combinar plataformas tradicionales con la colección de chips de Battle Network.

game.name: RUN=DIM - Return to Earth
game.desc: In the early 21st century, due to the global warming that has accelerated since the end of the previous century, several tens of percent of the earth's land was submerged. Many big cities were submerged in the sea, and the global economy was devastated. The year is 2052. The world has established a new order centered on the two major camps, the Space Development Organization ?Jesus? and the International Civil Organization ?Green Frontier?. The two major organizations that were born as a result of repeated mergers by large corporations around the world will eventually become more tense over space development initiatives. And, with the surprise attack on the side of Jesus, the two camps finally enter the battle! The player chooses and plays either pilot Kazuhito Moriguchi (boarding machine RUN = DIM) or Kanna Aso (boarding machine I = RA) belonging to the Green Frontier camp. The game consists of 6 stages.

game.name: SD Gundam - Operation U.C.
game.desc: Operation U.C. es un shooter de desplazamiento. Toma el control del Gundam original, Zeta o ZZ y lucha contra sus respectivos rivales.

game.name: Tetris
game.desc: Tetris es una de las muchas versiones del famoso juego soviético de apilar bloques. Las piezas del juego de cuatro bloques (apodados “Tetriminós”) caen en un hoyo cuadrado de 10 x 20 y deben organizarse en filas completas, que luego desaparecen para revelar más espacio en el tablero de juego. A medida que se borran las líneas, la velocidad del juego aumenta hasta que los Tetriminos llegan a la cima del pozo o el jugador alcanza la meta del modo actual. Esta versión presenta tres modos para un jugador: Modo Maratón, que continúa hasta que el jugador pierde; Modo de 40 líneas, que implica completar 40 líneas; y el modo de 3 minutos, donde el objetivo es acumular tantos puntos como sea posible en un límite de tiempo de 3 minutos. También hay un modo versus de 2 jugadores que utiliza el cable de enlace de WonderSwan, que es muy similar a la versión de Game Boy.

game.name: Alchemist Marie & Elie : Futari no Atelier
game.desc: En la ciudad de Salburg, siempre ha existido una larga tradición de alquimia, una ciencia mágica que se ocupa de combinar diversos materiales y transformar metales en oro. Juegas como dos jóvenes, Marlone y Elvira, quienes deben estudiar en la Academia de Alquimia, crear objetos poderosos y demostrar a sus maestros que son dignas de convertirse en verdaderas alquimistas. El juego combina elementos de rol y simulación. Debes leer libros y hablar con personas para aprender más sobre los objetos, y luego comprarlos o encontrarlos en algún lugar. Es necesario combinar objetos poderosos para impresionar a tus maestros. También desarrollas a tus personajes de manera típica de los juegos de rol. Puedes equiparles armas y armaduras, y luchar contra enemigos aleatorios en áreas silvestres. Ganas niveles y te haces más fuerte a medida que enfrentas más enemigos. Las batallas son automáticas, y solo puedes asignar una estrategia general a tus personajes.

game.name: Another Heaven : Memory of Those Days
game.desc: A principios del verano, se producen dos incidentes violentos en Tokio. Uno es un caso de asesinato llamado "Mad Cook", y el otro es un caso de homicidio continuado llamado "Pyromania". El detective de la comisaría de Suginami, Koichiro Hasegawa (el protagonista), está a cargo de las investigaciones de los casos "Mad Cook" y "Pyromania", junto con la detective Niko Nishitani, enviada desde la oficina principal. Basada en el escenario creado para el programa "D's Garage 21", esta historia cuenta con la supervisión del autor original Joji Iida. El guion, que abarca 900 páginas manuscritas, da lugar a más de 20 finales diferentes.

game.name: Arc the Lad : Kijin Fukkatsu
game.desc: Hace dos generaciones, hubo una gran batalla entre los humanos y las máquinas. Lideradas por su dios malvado, las máquinas lograron ganar la batalla y tomar el control del mundo. Juegas como Elc, el héroe de Arc the Lad 2. Como siempre, Elc es un mercenario independiente que recibe asignaciones de su gremio. En su camino, se encuentra con Finia, una chica que formaba parte de un grupo de resistencia y cuya madre fue asesinada por las máquinas. Con la ayuda de otros amigos, los héroes deben salvar a la humanidad y restaurar el mundo a la normalidad. Esta es una historia paralela de la serie Arc the Lad, ambientada en un entorno futurista. Al igual que en los clásicos de la saga, la navegación por las mazmorras se percibe como una serie de combates continuos. Mueves a tus héroes en un modo por turnos, mientras los enemigos realizan sus movimientos durante los suyos. Puedes atacar cuando un enemigo se encuentra en un cuadro cercano a ti y también usar una variedad de técnicas especiales.

game.name: Blue Wing Blitz
game.desc: There are six nations living in the world of floating islands. The most powerful one is the Ordia Empire, possessing the best aircrafts in the world. But its leaders were hungry for even more power, and planned to invade and to occupy the other five nations. The other nations tried to maintain diplomatic relationship with the Empire as long as possible. But one of those countries, the Esk Republic, decided to send a special strike team of skillful pilots, attempting to initiate a secret rebellion against the Empire. A young pilot named Keid, guided by his senior partner, the girl Payer, is the one who was chosen for this mission.

game.name: Dark Eyes - Battle Gate
game.desc: Dark Eyes ~ Battle Gate tells the story of a battle between two races on a pioneer planet. This Strategy RPG also supports the WonderGate, allowing additional features to be downloaded with a cellular phone

game.name: Dicing Knight.
game.desc: En Dicing Knight sigues el viaje de un caballero sin nombre mientras lucha a través de una serie de mazmorras generadas aleatoriamente. El juego comienza en el suelo de una mazmorra, y tu objetivo es encontrar la llave del piso para avanzar al siguiente piso. Eventualmente llegarás al jefe de una mazmorra. Después de vencerlo, tendrás acceso a una nueva mazmorra más difícil. Las mazmorras se cronometran mediante un "medidor de comida" que, cuando se agota, requiere que salgas de la mazmorra.

game.name: Digimon Adventure 02 - D1 Tamers
game.desc: This is a sequel to Digimon Adventure 02: Tag Tamers, set in the world of digital monsters based on the popular manga series. After having defeated the evil Millenniumon, our hero Ryou thought that would be his last travel to the Digiworld. However, the four sacred Digimons summon him once again, to participate in the D1 monster fighting tournament. But that is not all: it appears that Millenniumon is still alive, and is looking for revenge! Now Ryou has to win the tournament and defeat his archenemy once again. The gameplay is nearly identical to that of the previous game. You travel through top-down and isometric locations, fighting monsters with your own monster team, and then recruiting new monsters and assembling a collection. The battles are turn-based and are viewed from an isometric perspective. The monsters have various kinds of attacks in their disposal. Each attack is shown as a short animated sequence.

game.name: Digital Monster Card Game - Ver. WonderSwan Color
game.desc: Monstruo digital Ver. WonderSwan es un juego de simulación virtual de crianza de mascotas. El jugador puede criar y hacer luchar hasta ocho criaturas Digimon diferentes al mismo tiempo. El jugador también puede conectar el juego con otros productos Bandai Digimon e incluso para Sony PlayStation.

game.name: Dokodemo Hamster 3 - Odekake Saffron
game.desc: This is the third in Bandai's "hamster simulation" series. In this game, you are the "master" of a hamster. The game flows in real time, but you can interfere and perform various actions. The hamster has its own room in a house, with a table and a wheel. There are many things you can do with the hamster. You can take in to a stroll in the forest, go shopping with it, make it play with a ball, and so on. You can also perform actions unrelated to the hamster, like re-decorating the house or writing and painting on a piece of paper. The game features a point-and-click interface: you move your cursor over an object (such as hamster or calendar), which brings up an action menu.

game.name: Dragon Ball
game.desc: The game is based on the famous Dragon Ball manga series, starring Son Goku, and spans a long time period of the hero's life. It begins with Son Goku being a mere child and meeting the mysterious Bulma who asks him to add her on her quest to find seven Dr

game.name: Flash Koibito-kun
game.desc: Flash Koibito-Kun is a Puzzle game, developed by Koto and published by Koubunsha, which was released in Japan in 2000.

game.name: From TV Animation One Piece - Chopper no Daibouken
game.desc: Un día, los Piratas de Sombrero de Paja viajan a una isla misteriosa. Mientras los de Sombrero de Paja exploran la isla, de repente todos se convierten en animales; Luffy en un mono, Zoro en un tigre, Sanji en un zorro, Nami en un gato, Usopp en un kappa y Robin en un loro. Solo Chopper permanece como estaba. Depende de Chopper no solo ayudar a la tripulación a regresar a su estado original, sino también descubrir la causa de su misteriosa transformación. El juego es un juego de rol de acción estándar; los enemigos deambulan por el paisaje y puedes elegir atacarlos o ignorarlos. También puede utilizar el botón "defender" para reducir el daño infligido por un ataque inesperado.

game.name: From TV Animation One Piece - Niji no Shima Denset
game.desc: The story is based on the Baroque Works Saga. The straw hats finds a new companion who uses a boomerang as weapon. Along with the new companion they must fight Baroque Works and save Alabasta.

game.name: From TV Animation One Piece - Treasure Wars
game.desc: In the game the player will choose one of the characters from the Straw Hat Pirates and will fight another member of the Straw Hat Pirates within the board game. The main goal for the player is to find the treasure or special item before his opponent does. Each player will run around the board fighting against other pirates. The members of the crew the player did not choose as his or her character will also be running around along with other enemies.

game.name: From TV Animation One Piece - Treasure Wars 2 - Bu
game.desc: Much like the first Treasure Wars the player is to race to the treasure first. This time though the player choose one of the straw hats and battle against Buggy the Clown and his crew. New to the Straw hats is Nico Robin.

game.name: Front Mission
game.desc: Misión frontales un juego de rol de estrategia por turnos jugado desde una perspectiva isométrica. Los jugadores progresan en la historia a través de grandes batallas estratégicas que involucran múltiples unidades y escenas entre ellos. En ciertos lugares, generalmente ciudades, el jugador puede visitar múltiples ubicaciones, incluidos bares y tiendas, y hablar con la gente. También se encuentran tiendas para comprar nuevas armas, piezas y hacer reparaciones. En combate, cada robot Wanzer es una unidad separada que tiene una gran variedad de armas y estilos de ataque dependiendo de lo que esté equipado. Las unidades obtienen experiencia para derrotar enemigos y también para usar varias técnicas. Cuanto más se usa un ataque, más poderoso se vuelve.

game.name: Gekitou! Crash Gear Turbo - Gear Champion League
game.desc: El jugador es el protagonista del anime, Koya Marino, que aspira a convertirse en el mejor luchador de equipo del mundo. La personalización del equipo, los disparos y las entradas de comandos para los movimientos especiales que se activan durante la batalla son la clave de la victoria. Dado que cada parte tiene su propia técnica especial, el equipamiento de las piezas es el punto más importante. Hay más de 10.000 combinaciones de engranajes y piezas. Gana puntos ganando torneos, y puedes comprar partes más fuertes o afinarlas. Apunta a convertirte en campeón del mundo mientras luchas contra poderosos oponentes y rivales que aparecen uno tras otro en los torneos de batalla! ¿Quizás puedas jugar contra un misterioso luchador de engranajes cuando juegues contra un amigo?

game.name: Gensou Maden Saiyuuki Retribution - Hi no Ataru Ba
game.desc: Utopia, Togenkyo where humans and youkai coexist. An incident occurred in Togenkyo, and the youkai became violent and began to attack humans. In order to prevent the rebirth of the bull demon king who was the cause of this incident, the gods of the heavens ordered the four men, the Sanzo Houshi, Son Goku, Sago Jorge, and Hachihachi Command to stop the rebirth of the bull demon king. Players must choose only one partner from the four sisters, use their daughters and Sanzos to make money at the stalls, and make money for the accommodation. Can you grow your sales steadily and earn your rent safely? In addition, during the game, mini-games such as ?card game?, ?monster extermination game? and ?puzzle game? are also hidden.

game.name: Gransta Chronicle
game.desc: The combat adopts the simulation battle method. Because the friend or foe is disordered on the wide field, let's challenge it by making good use of the weapons, magic, and all items. The items and monsters can be

game.name: GunPey EX
game.desc: Direct sequel to the original Gunpey on the WonderSwan, Gunpey EX adds a number of new elements to the classic; most notably, color. In addition to earning points for completing a line across the field you will now earn points if those lines are of a matching color. Previously only gray lines were possible now red, blue, and green lines appear. Gunpey EX has the same modes as the previous game, except a story mode. Time Attack mode where one has to eliminate as many tiles as possible in two of five minutes. Endless mode give the player unlimited time to crank out whatever score they desire. Stage mode presents a set number of tiles to remove in a given time. Puzzle mode puts the player in the situation of having to remove a certain group of tiles, the player can change the color of the lines here when they swap their tiles positions. A link mode is available to play against another human with a WonderSwan and Gunpey EX. This game could access the internet through a wireless phone and the WonderGate where it was able to interact with an online high score board.

game.name: Hanjuku Hero - Ah, Sekai yo Hanjuku Nare...!!
game.desc: Hanjuku Eiyu is set in a semi-comical universe called the Egg World, populated by two nations: Hanjuku and Kanjuku, or soft-boiled and hard-boiled eggs, respectively. You take the role of the commander of the Hanjuku army, and your goal is to guide it successfully through a series of events (called "tales"), capturing enemy castles and defeating the bosses of the Kanjuku army. This is a real-time war strategy game. The game time is divided into months, each month taking a few minutes of real time. You control the hero and his generals, each one commanding units of foot soldiers. You send your army commanders through the world map to capture enemy castles. Once all the castles are captured, a new construction appears on the map, where the level boss resides, and your final goal in the chapter (tale) is to defeat this boss. Once you run into an enemy, an automatic battle sequence occurs, which you can interrupt, assigning commands to your army. Both Hanjuku and Kanjuku armies can summon powerful creatures called Egg Monsters, who can fight against a whole army or against each other in turn-based combat. Each month a "monthly event" occurs, such as changes in the land, earthquake, etc. Random events also pop out, during which you can buy supplies for your army.

game.name: Hunter X Hunter - Greed Island
game.desc: Cuando encuentras al enemigo, comienzas un sistema de batalla por turnos en un campo de batalla de 8x3 casillas con un sistema de selección de comandos.

game.name: Hunter X Hunter - Michibikareshi Mono
game.desc: La trama de 'Hunter x Hunter' sigue a Gon, un chico que, doce años antes de la historia que nos cuenta Togashi, fue abandonado por su padre -Ging Freecss-, quien lo dejo en manos de su tía Mito, en Isla Ballena. Gon siempre pensó que sus padres habían muerto, pero un día descubre que esto no es así gracias al aprendiz de su padre, Kite. Él le dice que no solo su padre está vivo, sino que es uno de los mejores cazadores (personas de élite acreditadas para buscar tesoros secretos, cazar bestias exóticas e incluso personas) del mundo. Al saber esto, Gon se motiva para dejar su hogar en Isla Ballena y presentarse a los exámenes de cazador. Para formar parte de esa élite necesita pasar seis exámenes donde pondrán a prueba sus habilidades y dominar el Nen (Fuerza Mental). El Nen es una técnica que permite a un ser vivo usar y manipular su propia energía vital (aura), aprender estas técnicas es el último paso para convertirse en un cazador profesional, gracias a esto pueden mejorar sus ataques físicos u objetos -dependiendo del aura del usuario-.

game.name: Hunter X Hunter - Sorezore no Ketsui
game.desc: The story of Hunter X Hunter focuses on a young boy named Gon Freecss, who one day discovers that the father he had always been told was dead was ali

game.name: Inuyasha - Fuuun Emaki
game.desc: In the previous game ?Kagome no Sengoku Nikki?, the game was played from the viewpoint of Kagome. This time you can play the game from the perspective of Maitreya, Samurai, Cloisonne, Steel Fang, Naraku, and Seiseimaru. For example, even in the same scene, it is possible to play from the viewpoint of Kagome the first time, the second time from the viewpoint of Inuyasha, and the third time from the viewpoint of Seiseimaru. Furthermore, the battle scene of this work is action. A support system has also been added, so you can experience the powerful battle of Inuyasha. In addition, an original character newly created by the original author, Rumiko Takahashi, will also appear!

game.name: Inuyasha - Kagome no Sengoku Nikki
game.desc: Inuyasha: Kagome no Sengoku Nikki is a "Fureai Adventure" where the player becomes the heroine Kagome Higurashi and communicates with Inuyasha. The story of Inuyasha changes depending on how the players interact. The game is divided into the ?Inuyasha Forest? part that contacts with Inuyasha using commands such as ?Item? and ?Topic?, and the ?Search? part that advances the story while adventuring with friends. If you do many events that occur in the ?Exploration? part, the topics and items in the ?Inuyasha Forest? part will increase, and the interaction with Inuyasha will become even more fulfilling. In addition, since the clock is built in the cassette, the game progresses in real time while linking with the actual time. Of course, many famous scenes of the original are recorded during the game, and familiar characters and enemy monsters appear. There are many original episodes such as the appearance of the original character ?Itachi no Shippu? as a rival to Inuyasha. You can also review stories in the ?Album Diary? and enjoy mini-games such as ?Hide and Seek?.

game.name: Inuyasha - Kagome no Yume Nikki
game.desc: The third Inuyasha game Kagome no Yume Nikki is a sequel to the first Kagome no Sengoku Nikki. As you can see from the word ?Yume? in the title, ?Dream? is an important factor in this ?Dream Diary?. The basic system of the game is the same as Sengoku Nikki, and the story is advanced while repeating the "contact part" and "adventure part", but this time a "dream event" occurs at the end of the day. In "Dream Event", you can see situations that cannot be seen in anime and manga, as well as modern events that were requested in the previous work. This time, the enemy is also named after the dream. The enemy this time is an original character called Yakumo, a half-witch who manipulates dreams, and a battle in the dream world will be unfolded. The game has a lot of original scenes, and the total number of events is 2.5 times higher than the previous work Sengoku Nikki.

game.name: Judgement Silversword - Rebirth Edition
game.desc: En tu caza espacial, el S-AIXAK, te enfrentarás a los secuaces de Judgement Silversword. Comenzando desde una pequeña estación espacial sobre la Tierra, tu luchador solitario atravesará el cosmos lleno de balas, siempre a un tiro de distancia de la muerte, para lograr este objetivo. Judgement Silversword es un juego de disparos de desplazamiento vertical en el que oleada tras oleada de diversas naves enemigas intentarán derribarte con balas, bombas, láseres o incluso sus propios fuselajes.

game.name: Kidou Senshi Gundam - Giren no Yabou - Tokubetsu H
game.desc: El jugador elige el Colegio Garma Zabi o el Colegio Ma Kube. Desde el punto de vista de dos personas que son fuerzas terrestres, el juego avanza con el objetivo de convertirse en el campeón de la tierra. El corazón del juego es el sistema de reuniones ejecutivas. Durante la reunión, se pueden discutir y decidir diversas propuestas con otros ejecutivos. También se pueden hacer observaciones mediante comandos y regateos, incluidas negociaciones avanzadas.

game.name: Kidou Senshi Gundam Seed
game.desc: Kidou Senshi Gundam Seed es un juego de acción con 8 fases. El jugador controla el Strike Gundam, ¡mientras intenta destruir los trajes móviles de Gin y Shigu de Zaft y los Gundam enemigos en los escenarios de colonias, espacio exterior y desierto! El Strike Gundam puede modificarse con piezas opcionales en función de la situación, así que ten en cuenta las características de cada equipo, como centrarte en la movilidad con un pack de striker ale, en el combate cuerpo a cuerpo con un pack de striker espada o en la potencia de fuego con un pack de striker lanzador. Tras superar el juego con Strike Gundam, podrás jugar a las historias secundarias de Aegis Gundam, Duel Gundam, Blitz Gundam, Buster Gundam y el nuevo Freedom Gundam.

game.name: Kidou Senshi Gundam Vol. 1 - Side 7
game.desc: Kidou Senshi Gundam Vol. 1 SIDE7, es un juego de estrategia que recrea varios episodios de la original serie de animación "Mobile Suit Gundam".

game.name: Kidou Senshi Gundam Vol. 2 - Jaburo
game.desc: El segundo de una trilogía de juegos de Wonderswan basados en el anime original de Mobile Suit Gundam. Este juego cubre los episodios 13-30 de la serie.

game.name: Kidou Senshi Gundam Vol. 3 - A Baoa Qu
game.desc: Muchos héroes han luchado a lo largo de los siglos. Los soldados tocan una melodía resonante, sus huellas moldean el curso de la historia. Incluso ahora, sus historias se leerán desde un rincón del Panteón. Para aquellos con remordimientos en el corazón, comienza la batalla. Esta es una historia de héroes caídos en el espacio.

game.name: Kinnikuman IIsei - Choujin Seisenshi
game.desc: Kinnikuman Nisei: Ch?jin Seisenshi is an RPG game based in the Kinnikuman/Ultimate Muscle series, although the plot of the game bears no relation to any of the original series' sagas. Here you will take the role of an anonymous guy -created specially for this game- named "The Mask" (although you can change his name for one of your choice) and will have to defeat all the characters of the Kinnikuman universe that appear in your way.

game.name: Kinnikuman IIsei - Dream Tag Match
game.desc: Kinnikuman Nisei: Dream Tag Match is a wrestling game based in the manga/anime series of the same name. It features the cast of Kinnikuman Nisei (known in the West as "Kinnikuman: Second Generations") in a battle to victory. The main story follows Kid Muscle, the prince of Muscle Planet and son of King Muscle (the early protagonist of the series), who fought for peace and justice in the Universe. Kid has now been chosen as King Muscle's predecessor in wrestling history, and must now defeat every opponent that comes his way, stopping total domination by the Demon Manufacturing Plant, an evil wrestling league which wants to take control of the universe, and the loss of his fanbase, which includes the love of his life, Roxanne.

game.name: Kurupara!
game.desc: Kurupara! is a puzzle game, in which panels arranged in a 5x5 field are rearranged and erased. To turn off the panel, you must first arrange three or more of the same pattern. Then, when three panels are arranged, the pattern drawn on the surface disappears and the panel is turned over. And if you put three or more panels that are turned over again, the pattern on the back will disappear and the panel will disappear. Repeat this and all the panels disappear to clear the stage.

game.name: Last Alive
game.desc: Perhaps not the most 'Adventureous" adventure game.

game.name: Meitantei Conan : Yuugure no Oujo
game.desc: Cursed jewels, the party, and murder. And in the middle of it all, our shrank detective, Kudou Shinichi, who now goes by the name of Conan Edogawa. The player gathers clues by listening to other characters, gathering key words, and most importantly, deducing the truth behind the mystery. The game can be linked with the previously released Meitantei Conan titles for WonderSwan which will effectively alter the story and add a branching path. Notebook with data is compatible with the one from previous works can also be imported.

game.name: Memories Off - Festa
game.desc: A donjara game with Memories Off characters.

game.name: Namco Super Wars
game.desc: Namco Super Wars is a tactical role-playing game developed by Namco and published by Bandai for the Wonderswan Color. It is a crossover game, featuring characters from several classic Namco titles. The game is played on a square grid, on which both the player's and computer's units are placed. Each side takes turns moving and making actions with their units. Every character has a variety of attacks and special moves that can be selected when performing an action. Some of these consume Spirit Points, which slowly regenerate each turn. The game is divided into stages. Between each stage, the player is able to visit a shop and prepare his units before starting the next stage. Unlike most RPGs, characters do not gain levels for directly defeating opponents. Instead, completion of a map will reward the players with a number of level ups, which they can then distribute among their units as they wish.

game.name: Naruto - Konoha Ninpouchou
game.desc: In this RPG you play as Naruto Uzumaki, who has fallen from the Ninja School Academy. Although Naruto is a problem child in the village of Kinoha Hidden, he has a dream of becoming a ninja that surpasses his predecessor by inheriting the title of ?Hokage?, the highest rank of Shinobi.

game.name: Pocket no Naka no Doraemon
game.desc: Doraemon intends to return to Nobita's room. However, the place where he got back by mistake was your (the player) room. Doraemon, who feels the same wavelength between you and Nobita, decides to stay in your room for a while. Doraemon gives you a minidora as a proof of friendship. There are four types of minidoras: ?Nobita type? who only takes a nap, timid ?Sune husband type?, gentle ?Shizuka-chan type?, and ?Gian type? of Ramenbo. You choose one of these and grow a minidora with Doraemon. Minidora grows while watching the conversation between the player and Doraemon. Then, until the day when we part ways with Doraemon, the days spent by three people (player, Doraemon, Minidora) determine the ending of the game.

game.name: Romancing Sa-Ga
game.desc: Érase una vez, tres dioses malvados que lucharon contra los dioses santos, el santo Dios Padre escogió a un guerrero humano para ayudarlos. Finalmente, después de una guerra prolongada y terrible, el líder de los tres dioses malvados, la muerte, el mayor de ellos, se rindió. El dios malvado más joven, Schirach, se convirtió en humano y perdió sus poderes. El del medio, Saruin, estaba sellado en el mundo oscuro. Ahora, después de mil años, el sello de Saruin se ha debilitado, es hora de que tú, el héroe de la nueva generación, lo derrotes.

game.name: Saint Seiya - Ougon Densetsu Hen - Perfect Edition
game.desc: Saint Seiya Golden Legend and Golden Legend Complete Edition released on NES from 1987 and 1988 are revived in Wonderswan! This Perfect Edition combines the two NES versions into one with new graphics. In addition, the strongest enemy of Golden Legends that did not appear in the NES version has been added to the game.

game.name: SD Gundam Eiyuuden - Kishi Densetsu
game.desc: SD Gundam Eiyden: Kishi Densetsu es un videojuego desarrollado Bec y publicado por Bandai en marzo de 2001 para la WonderSwan Color. Se trata de una adaptación a videojuego de la serie basada en el anime Mobile Suit Gundam y más concretamente en Super Deformed Gundam. Forma parte de una serie de videojuegos de dos partes.

game.name: SD Gundam Eiyuuden - Musha Densetsu
game.desc: SD Gundam Eiyden: Musha Densetsu es un videojuego de rol desarrollado y publicado por Bandai en marzo de 2001 para WonderSwan Color. Se trata de una adaptación a videojuego de la serie de anime Mobile Suit Gundam y, en particular, de Super Deformed Gundam. Forma parte de una serie de dos videojuegos.

game.name: SD Gundam G-Generation - Gather Beat 2
game.desc: Gather Beat 2 es un juego de estrategia con un argumento original. Incluye contenido de Mobile Suit Gundam y subhistorias como 0080, 0083 y 08.

game.name: SD Gundam G-Generation - Mono-Eye Gundams
game.desc: El último juego de Wonderswan en la franquicia de la Generación G. A diferencia de los juegos de consola, Monoeye Gundams cuenta con un original argumento cruzado.

game.name: Senkaiden Ni - TV Animation Senkaiden Houshin Engi
game.desc: A beautiful female fox spirit named Dakki is controlling the emperor Chu-o and the ruling In dynasty, and is using her power over him to do evil in the nation. An immortal-in-training named Taikobo is chosen by the great immortal sages for the Houshin Project - to seal away or destroy the evil demons that infest the world. In the course of his adventures, Taikobo gathers other powerful companions and sets out to seal away the demons and eventually destroy the fox-spirit Dakki.

game.name: Shaman King - Asu heno Ishi
game.desc: This is an RPG with a branching storyline. Depending on your progress, you will be able to experience history that can't be found in the original work. Defeat Shamans in battles with your spiritual powers and Shaman energy.

game.name: Soroban Gu
game.desc: Este es un juego de puzzle de acción en el que los bloques aparecen uno tras otro y se alinean para ser borrados. Sin embargo, en este juego, la parte superior, inferior, izquierda y derecha de la pantalla se conectan en bucle. Como resultado, los bloques se conectan de manera inesperada. También se admite el modo de batalla, que es un clásico juego de puzzle de acción. En este modo hay tres niveles de dificultad, por lo que se puede jugar con amigos de diferentes niveles de habilidad.

game.name: Star Hearts - Hoshi to Daichi no Shisha
game.desc: Star Hearts is a WonderSwan Color exclusive fantasy action role-playing game set in the fictional world of Uras, which has a large floating fortress in the center. The protagonist is selectable by the player at the beginning of the game, either the boy or the girl depicted on the front cover, together with some input such as the name, date of birth, and a blood type. The story starts with the player character about to become the new village chief. The ceremony gets interrupted by a bunch of attacking monsters and the hero barely escapes with their life. The game uses a 3/4 view where the player moves in a vertical and horizontal way, can interact with other NPCs and fight enemies on the screen using projectiles or blunt weapons. Fighting is done in real-time, and after battling many weaker enemies, one will usually face a boss. While the player starts the game alone, they will get a pet companion, choosable out of four different types, in the middle of the journey. Leveling up is not done through gaining experience from combat, but instead by finding fairies scattered around the land.

game.name: Star Hearts - Hoshi to Daichi no Shisha - Taikenba
game.desc: Star Hearts is a WonderSwan Color exclusive fantasy action role-playing game set in the fictional world of Uras, which has a large floating fortress in the center. The protagonist is selectable by the player at the beginning of the game, either the boy or the girl depicted on the front cover, together with some input such as the name, date of birth, and a blood type. The story starts with the player character about to become the new village chief. The ceremony gets interrupted by a bunch of attacking monsters and the hero barely escapes with their life.
game.genre: Juego de Rol / RPG de Acción

game.name: Super Robot Taisen Compact 3
game.desc: Super Robot Taisen Compact 3 is a tactical role-playing game from the Super Robot Wars series. The main feature of the franchise is having a story that crosses over several popular mecha anime, manga and video games, allowing characters and mecha from different titles to team up or battle one another. The player usually gets to move their forces first, one at a time, then control switches to the game's AI.

game.name: Super Robot Taisen Compact for WonderSwan Color
game.desc: During battle, the player chooses a unit and takes an action by the commands available, such as movement, attacking, forming squads an

game.name: Terrors 2
game.desc: Terrors 2 is a interactive text-based story with accompanying images that feature the following Japanese pop stars: Risa Goto, Kaori Manabe, Erika Yamakawa, Nami Ichinohe, Yumi Uehara. The games story is one of horror slowly sneaking into a Japanese school. The plot is revealed through four scenarios. The choices you make in the story will affect the path it takes, as such there are numerous alternate ending to encourage multiple playthroughs. Terrors 2 could connect to the internet with the WonderGate so that ingame events would take place at the same time of day that the player was experiencing.

game.name: Uchuu Senkan Yamato
game.desc: Uchuu Senkan Yamato is a Strategy game, developed by Tom Create and published by Bandai Visual in Japan in 2001. Each of the game's 17 levels plays like an episode with text interchanges and battles (fought both in space and on various planets) that alternate between tactical moves and short cutscenes to show the results. There are also 8 new scenarios plugged in to freshen up the story with new enemies such as a hotshot Gamilas commander to rival General Lysis, a space creature or two, and the Siren of Space?a game version of the little-known manga spinoff, Eternal Story of Jura. Depending on performance and points earned, multiple endings are possible including one that incorporates the ?hologram Starsha' scene from the Yamato movie.

game.name: Ultraman - Hikari no Kuni no Shisha
game.desc: Sinister aliens and giant monsters are constantly threatening civilization. The only Earth organization equipped to handle these disasters is the Science Special Search Party (SSSP), a special police force with br

game.name: Wild Card
game.desc: Although made by Square, the famous Japanese RPG developer, "Wild Card" is a game that is very different from classic Asian RPGs. Most importantly, it is not story-driven. The game is based entirely on quests which are not connected by a story arc. You play a nameless character with no background and there is no plot information or development beside your own progress with the quests. The gameplay consists entirely of playing cards. In the beginning of the game, an enigmatic woman named Maria asks you a series of questions, to determine the cards you get. After that, your character begins an adventure in a town. Locations, other characters, inventory, your movement - everything appears in form of cards. To get quests, you must choose your correspondent cards when encountering different people. You can buy weapons and equipment, and also fight enemies in turn-based combat by choosing the cards from your deck. You gain levels and become stronger in a traditional RPG fashion.

game.name: With You - Mitsumete Itai
game.desc: With You is an adventure game with static graphics, in which the game advances as you choose what to do from a list of possible actions. Long time ago, a man and a woman made a promise, stating that although they were destined to be lonely souls, they should always remain together. But by a cruel joke of fate, they were separated and sealed into two jewels that were hidden for generations. Manami, who left the country 6 years before, has found one of the jewels while traveling. He will return to Japan to meet with their friends from childhood. This will entail a meeting of the two jewels again, for the second jewel seems to be owned by his father.

game.name: Namco Wonder Classic
game.desc: Wonder Classic is a golfing game developed by Yoshidayama-Workshop and published by Bandai in january 2011 for the WonderSwan Color. You will use different characters with specific abilities to your advantage. For example the character, Reiko Nagase nullifies the effects of wind, most others have certain benefits to certain types of shot. There are two starting characters and twenty-two unlockable and downloadable characters.

game.name: X - Card of Fate
game.desc: This is Tokyo - the keystone that keeps Earth from falling into ruin.

game.name: Digimon Tamers - Digimon Medley
game.desc: "Digimon Medley" is based on the popular manga and and animé series Digimon, in which ordinary Japanese children find a way into a digital world, where they help good digital monsters fight against evil ones. The game is not directly plot-related to Digimon Adventure or Digimon Tamers: Brave Tamer games. Instead, it follows more closely the actual episodes of the series. You play as various characters, such as the main hero Taichi and his friend Yamato from the first episodes, as well as heroes from the Digimon Tamers sub-series: Takato, Ruki, and Lee. The game is divided into short episodes, each one of which revives one of the battles in the series. You start with Digimon Tamers, as they venture into the DigiWorld, only to meet the enigmatic digimon named Impmon, who is up to some mischief. Each episode can be played as one of several available characters. Each character also has his/her own digimon who fights all the battles. The battles are random and occur while you are navigating your heroes through top-down dungeons. The attacks are displayed as short animé-style sequences. During your turn, you must press the A button repeatedly to increase the power of your attack. The enemy attacks simultaneously, and you have to invest enough power in your attack in order for it to connect.

game.name: Digital Monster - D-Project
game.desc: In this, the newest Digimon RPG game for the Wonderswan Color/Crystal, you're once again cast as a kid who's sent to the Digital World to save it (what else?), armed with nothing else but your partner digimon, your tamer know-how, and a machine that someh

game.name: Wizardry Scenario #1 : Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
game.desc: The Mad Overlord Trebor was once only power-mad, but went off the deep end after he acquired a magical amulet of immense power, only to have it stolen from him by his nemesis, the evil archmage Werdna. Werdna, not quite sure how to use the amulet properly, accidentally causes an earthquake which creates a ten-level dungeon beneath Trebor's castle. To avoid looking silly, Werdna declares the dungeon to be the new lair for him and his monster hordes. Trebor, not to be outdone, declares the labyrinth his new Proving Grounds where adventurers must prove themselves for membership in his elite honor guard, and incidentally retrieve his amulet in the process.

game.name: Digimon Tamers - Brave Tamer
game.desc: Based on the popular Digimon manga, this is a sequel to Digimon Adventure 02: D1 Tamers. The game picks up directly where the previous one ended. After yet another ultimate battle against the evil Millenniumon, during which he revealed to the hero Ryou a terrifying secret, there was a great explosion. Ryou comes to his senses in an unknown place. The only digital monster there explains to him that the explosion send Millenniumon to the future, while Ryou ended up in the past. And now Millenniumon is trying to take control over the main computer in the Digiworld, and it is Ryou's task to stop him once and for all, and to finally find the truth about his and his archenemy's identities. The gameplay is similar to that of the predecessors: you navigate your hero over the top-down view, descend into dungeons, fight monsters in turn-based combat, recruit them into your party, and send the new teams to fight new enemies. The battle are not isometric any more, but viewed entirely as animé-style pictures. Attacks are also depicted as animated sequences.
